name: injex
description: Find, decode and remove hidden text in your files: invisible Unicode, tag-character and emoji steganography, look-alike letters, hidden instructions in comments, PDFs and Word files, and risky AI-agent configuration.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: injex only reads files; it never runs code from the workspace.

commands.title: Scan the workspace for hidden text

injex.enable.description: Check open files for hidden text.

injex.minSeverity.description: Only report findings at least this severe.

injex.scanOnType.description: Check a file again while you type (otherwise on open and save).

injex.showDecoded.description: Show hidden characters and decoded hidden text inline, after the place they hide.

injex.auditAgentConfig.description: Audit AI-agent configuration (auto-approve settings, hooks, MCP servers, folder-open tasks, AI workflows).

injex.maxFileSize.description: Skip text files larger than this many bytes.

injex.maxDocumentSize.description: Skip PDF / Office / e-mail files larger than this many bytes in workspace scans.

injex.maxFiles.description: At most this many files in a workspace scan.
